jobs.description:
**Job Description: Junior Software Developer (Entry-Level / Fresher)**

* **Role:** Junior Software Developer (Full-Stack / Backend)
* **Experience Level:** Entry-Level (0–1 Year / Fresh Graduates)
* **Location:** Fully Remote (Work from anywhere in India)
* **Compensation:** ₹4.25 LPA (Cost to Company)
* **Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About the Role**We are looking for a motivated, entry-level **Software Developer** to join our fully remote engineering team. In this role, you will work closely with senior engineers to design, build, test, and maintain scalable web applications. This is a great opportunity for fresh graduates or self-taught coders looking to kick-start their software engineering career in a flexible, remote-first environment.**Key Responsibilities**

* **Write Clean Code.** Develop, test, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code using modern programming languages.
* **Collaborate Remotely.** Participate actively in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and code reviews via Slack, Zoom, and GitHub.
* **Build & Integrate Features.** Assist in building user-facing features and connecting them to backend APIs and databases.
* **Debug & Troubleshoot.** Identify bottlenecks and bugs in existing software and help implement timely fixes.
* **Document Work.** Maintain clear technical documentation for newly developed features, APIs, and codebase changes.

Pay: ₹425,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: Remote
